question.text: A circle is drawn whose centre is on the <math><mi>x</mi><mo>–</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math> and it touches the <math><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mo>.</mo></math> If no part of the circle lies outside the parabola <math><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then the maximum possible radius of the circle is

solution.text:
Let equation of circle is x-r2+y2=r2
Solving it with y2=8x, we get,
x2-2rx+r2+8x=r2⇒x=0 or x=2r-8
⇒rmaximum=4
